mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sku_price (sku_id, min_qty, max_qty, price, created_at) VALUES (#{skuId}, #{minQty}, #{maxQty}, #{price}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT sku_price_id AS skuPriceId, sku_id AS skuId, min_qty AS minQty, max_qty AS maxQty, price AS price, created_at AS createdAt FROM sku_price WHERE sku_id = #{skuId} ORDER BY min_qty ASC
